question: Can just two tiles be forced never to repeat?
answer: Yes, with just 2 tiles. Bumps and notches, or matching colours, say which edges may touch. Copy-and-shift always breaks a rule, so the only way to keep going is a pattern that never repeats, all the way to infinity.
move: Simple rules on the edges can force a pattern that never repeats.
